mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce the efficacy of norethindrone-containing oral contraceptives through effects on enterohepatic circulation and potential CYP450 enzyme induction, while NSAIDs can increase cardiovascular and thromboembolic risk in hormonal contraceptive users.
action: Use alternative contraception or backup contraceptive methods during indomethacin therapy and for 7 days after discontinuation; counsel on reduced OCP efficacy and increased thrombotic risk.
